rows.grounds: name or epithet of a figure in the ritual context; nominative singular
compound: yajinī (Yajinī) + yutaḥ (joined, accompanied); describes Bhramaṇa

items.question: Which companion is specified as joined with Bhramaṇa in this context?
premises: Bhramaṇaḥ names a figure present in the described context.
The element yutaḥ denotes being accompanied or joined.
Yajinī is identified as the companion in the compound.
items.inference: Bhramaṇa is present in the company of Yajinī.
uncertainties: The specific identities and roles of Bhramaṇa and Yajinī in this Merutantra passage are not fully determined from this verse alone.
